learningObjectives.text: Use present simple for habits, routines and facts
learningObjectives.textPersian: حال ساده را برای عادت‌ها، روال روزانه و واقعیت‌ها به کار ببر

learningObjectives.text: Use the -s ending correctly with he/she/it
learningObjectives.textPersian: پایانهٔ s را با he/she/it درست به کار ببر

learningObjectives.text: Choose between a and an
learningObjectives.textPersian: بین a و an درست انتخاب کن

learningObjectives.text: Use the for specific things and no article for general plurals
learningObjectives.textPersian: the را برای چیزهای مشخص و بدون حرف تعریف را برای جمع‌های کلی به کار ببر

learningObjectives.text: Form regular and common irregular past forms
learningObjectives.textPersian: شکل گذشتهٔ فعل‌های باقاعده و بی‌قاعدهٔ رایج را بساز

learningObjectives.text: Use did/didn't in questions and negatives
learningObjectives.textPersian: did و didn't را در سؤال و منفی به کار ببر

learningObjectives.text: Form -er/-est and more/most comparisons
learningObjectives.textPersian: مقایسه با -er/-est و more/most را بساز

learningObjectives.text: Use than and the correctly in comparisons
learningObjectives.textPersian: than و the را در مقایسه درست به کار ببر

learningObjectives.text: Use present perfect for experiences and unfinished time
learningObjectives.textPersian: حال کامل را برای تجربه‌ها و زمان ناتمام به کار ببر

learningObjectives.text: Choose between present perfect and past simple
learningObjectives.textPersian: بین حال کامل و گذشتهٔ ساده درست انتخاب کن

learningObjectives.text: Form if + present simple, will + base verb
learningObjectives.textPersian: ساختار if + حال ساده، will + فعل ساده را بساز

learningObjectives.text: Talk about real future possibilities
learningObjectives.textPersian: دربارهٔ احتمال‌های واقعی آینده صحبت کن

learningObjectives.text: Form passive sentences in present and past
learningObjectives.textPersian: جمله‌های مجهول را در حال و گذشته بساز

learningObjectives.text: Choose passive when the agent is unknown or unimportant
learningObjectives.textPersian: وقتی فاعل ناشناخته یا بی‌اهمیت است مجهول را انتخاب کن

topics.title: Verb To Be and Basic Questions
topics.titlePersian: فعل to be و سؤال‌های ساده

learningObjectives.text: Use am / is / are in statements and negatives
learningObjectives.textPersian: am / is / are را در جمله‌های مثبت و منفی به کار ببر

learningObjectives.text: Ask and answer simple questions with be and question words
learningObjectives.textPersian: با be و کلمه‌های پرسشی سؤال ساده بپرس و جواب بده

topics.title: Modal Verbs: Requests, Permission and Advice
topics.titlePersian: افعال مُدال: درخواست، اجازه و توصیه

learningObjectives.text: Make polite requests and ask for permission with can, could and would
learningObjectives.textPersian: با can، could و would مؤدبانه درخواست کن و اجازه بخواه

learningObjectives.text: Give advice and say what is necessary with should, must and have to
learningObjectives.textPersian: با should، must و have to توصیه کن و ضرورت را بگو

topics.title: Talking About the Future: going to, Present Continuous and will
topics.titlePersian: صحبت دربارهٔ آینده: going to، حال استمراری و will

learningObjectives.text: Talk about plans and arrangements with going to and the present continuous
learningObjectives.textPersian: با going to و حال استمراری دربارهٔ برنامه‌ها و قرارها صحبت کن

learningObjectives.text: Make decisions, offers and predictions with will
learningObjectives.textPersian: با will تصمیم‌های لحظه‌ای، پیشنهاد و پیش‌بینی بگو

topics.title: Second Conditional: Unreal and Unlikely Situations
topics.titlePersian: شرطی نوع دوم: موقعیت‌های غیرواقعی و بعید

learningObjectives.text: Form if + past simple, would + base verb
learningObjectives.textPersian: ساختار if + گذشتهٔ ساده، would + فعل ساده را بساز

learningObjectives.text: Talk about unreal or unlikely situations and give advice
learningObjectives.textPersian: دربارهٔ موقعیت‌های غیرواقعی یا بعید صحبت کن و توصیه کن

topics.title: Used To: Past Habits and States
topics.titlePersian: used to: عادت‌ها و وضعیت‌های گذشته

learningObjectives.text: Talk about past habits and states with used to
learningObjectives.textPersian: دربارهٔ عادت‌ها و وضعیت‌های گذشته با used to صحبت کن

learningObjectives.text: Contrast the past with the present
learningObjectives.textPersian: گذشته را با حال مقایسه کن

learningObjectives.text: Add emphasis with not only … but also, so … that and such … that
learningObjectives.textPersian: با not only … but also، so … that و such … that تأکید اضافه کن

learningObjectives.text: Express proportional change with the more … the more …
learningObjectives.textPersian: با the more … the more … تغییر متناسب را بیان کن
